name: Design experimental protocols for chemical synthesis and analysis
description: Users requested detailed protocols, experimental procedures, and technical guidance for synthesizing, analyzing, or testing chemical substances, ranging from pharmaceutical formulations and industrial processes to various hazardous or controlled materials. The requests involved specific methodologies for reactions, quality control, and safety assessments in both academic and practical chemical contexts.
